name: Vorn Skyseer
summary: Vorn Skyseer is a peaceful tauren resident of Camp Narache atop Red Cloud Mesa in Mulgore. Resting among the camp's tents, he greets young adventurers beginning their journeys and introduces them to local life.

sections.title: A Friendly Face at Camp Narache
sections.body: Situated in Camp Narache on Red Cloud Mesa, Vorn Skyseer serves as an informal welcoming presence for young tauren. As they undertake their rites of passage before venturing into the wider valleys of Mulgore, Vorn offers kind words and hospitality, helping new arrivals settle into the camp.

sections.title: A Detached Observer
sections.body: Vorn is no warrior. He leaves the camp's defense to its braves and keeps to a quiet, unhurried life, content to watch over the tranquil plains of his homeland.

faq.answer: Vorn Skyseer is an elder resident of Camp Narache in Mulgore. He primarily serves to welcome young tauren braves beginning their introductory rites at Red Cloud Mesa.

faq.q: Where can I find Vorn Skyseer?
faq.answer: He can be found resting outdoors among the tents of Camp Narache, atop Red Cloud Mesa in southwestern Mulgore.
He receives the Bloodhoof Village Gift Voucher in the quest Welcome!, greeting its bearer and offering a small companion to join them on their adventures.

angles.text: For young tauren on Red Cloud Mesa, Vorn Skyseer is often one of the first familiar, reassuring faces to greet them as they prepare to step into the wider life of Mulgore.
Vorn exemplifies the calm and steady nature of the plains tribes who have gathered under Cairne Bloodhoof's leadership to build a permanent home.
